en.headline: Two men injured, one unconscious, after taxi hits them in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Police said a taxi turning from Shanghai Street into Pak Hoi Street struck two men outside a barbecue restaurant early on Monday; both were taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital.
body: Two men were injured, one of them unconscious, after being struck by a taxi in Yau Ma Tei early on Monday, police said.
The accident happened at about 12.23am when a taxi travelling along Shanghai Street turned left into Pak Hoi Street and hit the two men. They were taken by ambulance to Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

Sources told local media that four people had been chatting outside a barbecue restaurant on Pak Hoi Street when the taxi turned and struck two of them. The driver reportedly told officers he had been looking for passengers at the time.
Police are investigating the circumstances of the collision. No arrests have been reported.

zh.headline: 油麻地的士轉灣撞倒兩男子 一人昏迷送院
zh.dek: 警方表示，週一清晨約十二時半，一輛的士由上海街轉入北海街時撞倒兩名男子，其中一人昏迷，兩人送伊利沙伯醫院。
body: 警方表示，週一清晨一輛的士在油麻地撞倒兩名男子，一人昏迷，另一人清醒，兩人送院治療。
事故約在十二時十三分發生，的士沿上海街行馳，轉入北海街時撞及兩人。傷者由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院。
消息指，事發時四人正在北海街一間燒烤店外聊天，的士轉灣時撞倒其中兩人。司機據報正在尋找乘客。
警方正調查事故經過，暫未有人被捕。
